goods.title: Kohereza umuzigo
goods.wishPriceHelper: Igiciro cy'umuzigo (Shyiramo igiciro cyangwa utegereze igiciro cy'umumotari/umunyonzi)

ride.title: Saba urugendo
ride.body: Kanda 'Saba moto' ahabanza, shyiramo aho uherereye n'aho ugiye, maze wohereze ubusabe bwawe. Umumotari araza kugufata aho uri.

parcel.title: Ohereza ipaki
parcel.body: Kanda 'Ohereza umuzigo', shyiramo aho ufatirwa n'aho ugezwa, hanyuma utange ibisobanuro ku muzigo no ku wakira. Umumotari afata umuzigo akawugeza aho woherejwe — wowe ntugenda nawo. Niba wifuza ko umuzigo ugera yo vuba, hitamo Byihuse.

bidding.title: Ibiciro no guhitamo umumotari
bidding.body: Numara kohereza ubusabe bwawe, abamotari bari hafi batanga ibiciro byabo. Gereranya ibiciro, ikigereranyo n'igihe bazagerera, hanyuma wemere igiciro wishimiye. Ushobora no gutanga igiciro cyawe — koresha akamenyetso k'igiciro gikwiye kugira ngo urebe icyo ingendo nk'iyi zitwara.

children.title: Kugendana n'abana
children.body: Abana bari munsi y'imyaka 12 ntibashobora gutumiza urugendo ubwabo kuri Bimoto — umwana agendana n'umuntu mukuru ubishinzwe, ari na we utumiza urugendo. Igihe utumiza urugendo, ushobora gushyiraho akamenyetso ka 'Uri kugendana n'umwana?' kugira ngo umumotari abimenye mbere yo kugera aho uri.

sos.title: Buto ya SOS
sos.body: Mu gihe cy'urugendo, akamenyetso gatukura ka SOS kohereza integuza ku ikipe ya Bimoto n'abantu washyizeho wakwiyambaza mu butabazi, kandi kakugumishiriza nimero y'ubutabazi ya 112 hafi ku buryo wayikanda rimwe gusa. Gakoreshe igihe cyose wumva utekanye. Umumotari n'umugenzi bafite buto imwe: uwayikanda wese, imenyesha abantu we ubwe yashyizeho yakwiyambaza mu butabazi.

language.title: Guhindura ururimi
language.body: Fungura Umwirondoro uhitemo English, Français cyangwa Kinyarwanda ahanditse Ururimi. Ibyo uhisemo birabikwa bigakoreshwa buri gihe ufunguye porogaramu.

help.title: Aho ubona ubufasha
help.body: Mu gihe cy'urugendo, koresha ikiganiro kiri muri app uvugane n'umumotari wawe. Ku bindi byose, vugisha ikipe ifasha abakoresha Bimoto ku ivuriro rya pilote cyangwa unyuze ku muhuza wawe — bashobora kugusubiriramo urugendo urwo ari rwo rwose.

trace.title: Inzira yandikwa
trace.body: Mu gihe cy'urugendo rwawe, telefoni y'umumotari yandika inzira munyuzemo — ku mutekano, no kugira ngo ikibazo cyose gishobore gukemurwa hashingiwe ku byabaye aho gushingira ku kwibuka. Isibwa nyuma y'iminsi 14 keretse hari ikibazo cyafunguwe; icyo gihe ibikwa kugeza igihe gikemukiye. Nta muntu n'umwe uyireba mu buryo buhita — keretse itsinda ryacu ry'umutekano mu gihe cy'ubutabazi, kugeza ubutabazi bufunzwe.

Hoherezwa gusa inyandiko z'amakosa zigaragara ku rupapuro rwa Diagnostics — ntabwo ari ubutumwa bwawe, ingendo zawe cyangwa aho uri. legal.privacyText: Bimoto ikusanya nomero ya telefoni yawe, aho uherereye (gusa iyo ubisabye) kugira ngo uguhuzwe n'umumotari/umunyonzi no kwishyura cyangwa kwishyurwa. Tubika amakuru yawe kandi ntituyasangiza abandi keretse bikenewe mu gukora ingendo. Ushobora gusiba konti yawe n'amakuru yose igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
legal.termsChildPolicy: Abana: abana bari munsi y'imyaka 12 ntibashobora gutumiza urugendo ubwabo. Umwana agendana n'umuntu mukuru ubishinzwe, ari na we utumiza urugendo kandi agumana n'umwana urugendo rwose.
legal.driverTermsText: Nk'umumotari wa Bimoto, wemera: gutanga ibiciro bihamye gusa, gutanga ubwikorezi bwizewe, gukurikiza amategeko y'umuhanda, kwambara no gutanga ingofero, kugira uruhushya rwa RURA n'ubwishingizi byemewe, no kwemerera GPS mu gihe cy'ingendo.
legal.diagnosticsConsent: Iyo porogaramu ihuye n'ikibazo, iyi telefoni yandika ibyabaye: isaha, verisiyo ya porogaramu, urupapuro wari uriho, n'ubutumwa bw'ikosa. Nimero za telefoni n'imibare yo kwinjira bikurwamo mbere yo kubikwa. Kugira ngo dukemure ibibazo vuba, izo nyandiko z'amakosa zoherezwa mu buryo bwikora ku ikipe ya Bimoto i Kigali. Ushobora kureba neza ibyoherezwa ku rupapuro rwa Diagnostics, kandi ushobora guhagarika kohereza kwikora igihe icyo ari cyo cyose muri Settings. Ubutumwa bwawe, ingendo zawe n'aho uri ntibijyanwa na rimwe.
legal.rideTraceNotice: Aho uri handikwa mu gihe cy'ingendo n'ubwikorezi bw'ibintu — ku mutekano, no gukemura amakimbirane hashingiwe ku byabaye. Inzira zibikwa iminsi 14 hanyuma zigasibwa; niba urugendo rufite ikibazo, inzira yarwo ibikwa kugeza ikibazo gikemutse. Nta muntu ushobora kureba ingendo zawe mu buryo buhita — keretse itsinda ryacu ry'umutekano mu gihe cy'ubutabazi, kugeza ubutabazi bufunzwe.
legal.safetyAckNoInfants: Nta mwana muto cyangwa uruhinja rwigeze rushobora gutwarwa kuri moto. Nta gahonzu na kamwe.
legal.safetyAckOnePassenger: Moto itwara umugenzi umwe gusa. Ntibabiri, kandi nta mwana wiyongera ku muntu mukuru.
legal.safetyAckMinimumAge: Umuntu wese utaragera ku myaka ngombwa yemewe n’amategeko yo kuba umugenzi wa moto ntashobora gutwarwa.
legal.safetyAckDriverRefuse: Nka umushoferi, wemera kandi ko uzanga urugendo rwose rwaba runyuranyije n’aya mategeko, n’ubwo umugenzi yabyifuza cyane.
legal.safetyAckAgree: Nasomye kandi nemera aya mategeko atatu y’umutekano

deletion.exportNotice: Iyi dosiye irimo amakuru Bimoto ifite kuri wowe nk’umugenzi, nk’umumotari, no nk’umwe mu bagize urugendo rwawe. Ku bushake ntirimo inyandiko zacu zo kurwanya uburiganya n’izo iperereza kuri iyi konti: ibimenyetso byo kurwanya iyezandonke, ibyemezo by’ubuyobozi byafashwe kuri wowe, igenzura ry’amazina atahuye, ibyemezo byihariye ku makimbirane y’umumotari, n’inyandiko isigara konti imaze gusibwa. Ibyo ntibitangwa kugira ngo igenzura ry’uburiganya ritasomwa n’uwo rireba. Ushobora kubisaba, hamwe n’impamvu zabyo, wandikira ubufasha bwa Bimoto.
deletion.step1ErasedDocuments: Uruhushya rwawe, ubwishingizi n'izindi nyandiko zawe
deletion.step1Intro: Banza usome ibi. Iyo gusiba bimaze gukorwa, ntibisubirwaho.
deletion.step1KeptRides: Inyandiko y'uko buri rugendo rwabaye — aho rwagiye n'igihe
deletion.step1KeptSafety: Inyandiko z'umutekano n'iz'amakimbirane, iyo urugendo rwarwo rwazigize
deletion.step1KeptWhy: Amategeko adusaba kubika izi nyandiko, kandi n'abandi bantu bari muri izo ngendo. Zirabikwa, ariko nta na kimwe kirimo kigaruka kuri wowe.
deletion.step1Window: Nta kintu kibaho ako kanya. Ufite amasaha 72 yo guhindura umwanzuro, kandi Bimoto ikora nk'ubusanzwe muri ayo masaha yose.
deletion.step2Hold: Fata kugira ngo usibe konti yanjye
deletion.step2HoldInstruction: Kanda ubuto buri hasi ubufate amasegonda abiri kugira ngo wemeze.
deletion.step2Warning: Ibi bitangiza kubara amasaha 72. Nyuma yayo, izina ryawe, nimero yawe ya telefone, abo uhamagara n'inyandiko zawe bizasibwa burundu.

help.is18OrOlder: Bimoto igenewe abamotari bafite imyaka 18 cyangwa irenga. Ntidushobora kukwakira uri munsi y'iyo myaka. Abari munsi y'imyaka 18 bashobora kwinjira mu itsinda rishinga muri uruhare rutandukanye.
help.holdsDriversLicence: Dukeneye uruhushya rwo gutwara rw'u Rwanda rufite agaciro ku bwoko bw'ikinyabiziga cyawe (A1 kuri moto, A2 muri rusange). « Biri mu nzira » bisobanura ko wasabye kandi ufite inyemezabuguzi cyangwa itariki y'ikizamini.
help.hasRuraAuthorisation: RURA ni Urwego rw'u Rwanda rugenga imirimo ifitiye igihugu akamaro. Uruhushya rurakenewe kugira ngo utware abagenzi ku bwishyu. Ntutinde niba utararufite — dushobora gufasha mu busabe bwawe.
help.primaryVehicleType: Hitamo ikinyabiziga uzakoresha kuri 50% cyangwa kurenga by'ingendo zawe. Ushobora kubihindura nyuma uhereye ku mwirondoro wawe.
help.cooperativeAffiliation: Bimoto ikorera binyuze mu makoperative y'ubwikorezi. Niba usanzwe uri muri rimwe, kurihitamo byihutisha kwinjira kuko dufitanye umubano n'umuyobozi wawe. Niba utari, nta kibazo — tuzaguhuza.
help.primaryCityBand: Uzafata abakiriya he ahanini? Kigali rwagati = uturere two hagati (Kacyiru, Nyamirambo, Kimironko). Kigali hanze = inkengero. Bugesera = inzira y'amajyepfo igana Nyamata.
help.weeklyAvailabilityHours: Vuga ukuri. Abamotari benshi bakora bakora amasaha 20 cyangwa arenga mu cyumweru. Igihe gito kiremewe mu gihe cyo gutangira kandi ushobora kubihindura nyuma.
help.priorPlatformExperience: Yego, SafeMotos, cyangwa indi porogaramu nk'izo. Bidufasha kumva uko umenyereye gukoresha telefoni igendanwa. Ntibisabwa.
